macros.name: alignR
macros.doc: To align the table cell text left, center or right we add or remove vfill-part of the left and right padding.

macros.name: cell
macros.doc: \cell creates a table cell, puts it to the current row and updates decorations.

macros.name: lastrule
macros.doc: Typesets the last rule (bottom frame) of a table chunk.

macros.name: spancontent
macros.doc: Typesets a spanned cell (the content is in the implicit argument) and puts it to the current row.
